Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, ws2 As Worksheet, wso As Object, p As Object, r As Variant
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & ":" & TypeName(ws.CustomProperties)
    Case 1
        Set p = ws.CustomProperties.Add("Key", "Val")
        r = TypeName(p) & ":" & p.Name & "=" & p.Value
    Case 2
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Key", "Val"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\one.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Num", 5
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Dbl", 1.5
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Bool", True
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Day", #1/2/2024#
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\types.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 4
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Key", "a"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Key", "b"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\duplicate.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Key", "a"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "KEY", "b"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 6
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "", "a"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 7
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Key", ""
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\blank.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 8
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "A", "2"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\order.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 9
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "A", "2"
        r = ws.CustomProperties(1).Name & ws.CustomProperties.Item(2).Name
    Case 10
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        r = ws.CustomProperties("B").Value
    Case 11
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        r = ws.CustomProperties(2).Value
    Case 12
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        r = ws.CustomProperties(0).Value
    Case 13
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "A", "2"
        ws.CustomProperties(1).Delete
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\deleted.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 14
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties(1).Value = 7
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 15
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties(1).Name = "C"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 16
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties(1).Value = Empty
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 17
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", Null
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 18
        Set wso = ws
        wso.CustomProperties.Add "B"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 19
        Set wso = ws
        wso.CustomProperties.Add Value:="x"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 20
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", ws.Range("A1")
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 21
        ws.Range("A1").Value = "cell"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", ws.Range("A1")
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 22
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", Array(1, 2)
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 23
        ws.CustomProperties.Add String(300, "n"), "v"
        r = Len(ws.CustomProperties(1).Name)
    Case 24
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "n", String(70000, "v")
        r = Len(ws.CustomProperties(1).Value)
    Case 25
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "a b!", "x y"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\odd.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 26
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.Copy After:=ws
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(2)
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 27
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        r = TypeName(ws.CustomProperties.Parent) & TypeName(ws.CustomProperties(1).Parent) & ws.CustomProperties.Creator & ws.CustomProperties(1).Creator
    Case 28
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", "1"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "A", "2"
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\reopen.xlsx"
        wb.Close
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\reopen.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 29
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Num", 5
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "Day", #1/2/2024#
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\reopen_types.xlsx"
        wb.Close
        Set wb = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\reopen_types.xlsx")
        Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
    Case 30
        Set ws2 = wb.Worksheets.Add(After:=ws)
        ws2.CustomProperties.Add "S2", "two"
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "S1", "one"
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\two_sheets.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 31
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "B", 1E+300
        ws.CustomProperties.Add "C", 1.23456789012345
        For Each p In ws.CustomProperties: r = r & "|" & p.Name & "=" & TypeName(p.Value) & ":" & p.Value: Next: r = ws.CustomProperties.Count & r
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\numbers.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
    Tried = CStr(r)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String, ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
